checks.result: Probe commands use the shared supervisor route and retain mux refusal logging. Exit 255 plus the client's session-open-refusal diagnostic constructs SessionLimitRefusal from the original destination. The helper truncates that destination to a bounded raw excerpt and expressly defers final escaping. run preserves this typed error while replacing ordinary command failures with fixed prerequisite text; probe stringifies it, refresh caches it, and view clones it. OpenSSH's real failed session-confirmation path emits the matched refusal; its fallback failure behavior is also expressly described by the implementation spec. Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openssh/openssh-portable/V_9_9_P2/mux.c . This conditional path needs both channel refusal and failed fallback, not merely any probe failure.
